facts.claim: Star Pride (Windstar Cruises): Entered service 1988; 42,000 GT; 312 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 242 m length; Star Plus class.
Star Pride was the first of three German built cruise ships that were initially built for the Seabourn Cruise Line.
She was known as Seabourn Pride and is now operated for Windstar Cruises and was the first of her class.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Windstar Cruises; entered service 1988; 42,000 GT; approx. 312 guests.
